reviews.text:
Hi it's Mr Ivo Javier Da Silva Henriques I am so happy with the job you have done but boy he still crying to go outside going around the house to find a way out he not settle down at home the only way he sitting down is when he as sleep resting but I am not letting him go outside anymore.

Thank you for helping boy to get him better and sitting down.
Thank you to everyone in Creature comforts.

We love the team at Creature Comforts and literally never walk past without dropping in to say hi. Maybe something about the treat bar 🤔 The practice here in Notting Hill is new and super clean, never smelly! The subscription is really great value and means you never think twice about checking things out. 🥰😎 …

Creature Comforts Notting Hill is the best best vet around! Our sweet Toast has quite a few medical issues so we spend a lot of time with the team and I can’t say enough positive things. They are so caring, thoughtful and supportive. Hugely appreciative especially of Jake who goes above and beyond with our sweet boy! And Jess who has survived quite a number of blood tests that Toast refuses with extreme theatrics. They are just the best 💜💜💜
Incredible service very much looked after here!

We met Dr Maria for the first time and she gave our cat her very first vaccine and deep ear clean from ear mites. Dr Maria’s kindness, calmness and very knowledgeable approach made me and my partner feel very at ease that our cat is in safe hands. Our cat also felt very relaxed with Dr Maria and the vaccination was absolutely seamless. After leaving the appointment we felt that Dr Maria will be our go to veterinarian after her amazing approach and knowledge to all the questions and queries we had for her.

A big thank you to Jake and the team for taking such great care of my senior dog, Motti, during his dental surgery. I was quite worried, but they kept me updated throughout the day and made the whole experience reassuring. Excellent care and professional work, with no complications or infections and a very quick recovery. Highly recommend!
I honestly appreciate u so much
Fantastic vets, really friendly staff and so welcoming.
Thank you so much! 💜 …

Writing
I take my dog Millie to Creature Comforts in Westbourne Park, and I honestly cannot praise the staff enough. They are amazing and treat Millie as if she were one of their own. It is lovely to know she is in such caring and capable hands. The app is also so easy to use, and being able to book appointments whenever needed is a real bonus. I would highly recommend Creature Comforts to anyone looking for a caring, friendly and professional team for their pets. Thank you for looking after Millie so well! ❤️🐾

Fantastic vet. Helpful and friendly staff, and excellent value too, with reasonable and transparent pricing too. Since I’ve joined they’ve sorted out some issues my dog has been having which the previous vet wasn’t able to. The app is very useful too.
Brilliant service
Brilliant vets,  staff are so friendly. I highly reccomend.

It was the best decision to switch to Creature Comforts. They took their time for my nervous Husky to warm up to them and all our visits have been better than the last. Pricing is fair and transparent compared to other vets. Highly recommend!
Excellent vets! Very friendly and helpful!
The best care from everyone here , cannot recommend it enough
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review Camila, we really appreciate it! Hopefully one day we'll make it to 5* 🙏💜 …

Considering the area, I expect the Vet to be great.
Mortimer, our 6year old Ragdoll has been with them for a few years. I can only speak for the CComforts in my area but where they do incredibly well is the personal touch. From the Vets to more importantly the reception staff, knowing that they care on a personal level, makes all the difference to us pet parents.

PS- walking in and getting your pet harness set and adjusted (for cats) by the team both shows and is an extra bonus!

Holly our Labrador came in to have a nasty puncture wound inflicted from a large Alsatian looked at.  The vet was lovely and Holly was delighted with the ‘all you can eat’ snacks and free tennis balls!
Very helpful staff.

I couldn’t be happier with Creature Comforts Vets in Notting Hill. The whole team is always so friendly, caring, and helpful, and they treat my gorgeous Blu with so much love and kindness every time we visit. It’s clear they genuinely care about the animals and their owners. Highly recommended! ❤️🐾 …
Professional, and really friendly. The vets here are informative and communicate excellently to owners. Cannot recommend it more highly!

We have been going to this vet regularly for the past year and a half. I can only say good things about our experience with Jake and Sam - they are highly knowledgeable, always listen to my concerns and provide clear action plans for all the issues my two cats have been going through. Thank you for everything you do (and for always squeezing me in at the last minute!).

Perfect experience.  Wonderful people,  very caring and amazing with animals ( and human kinds too). Highly recommended 👌 especially Dr Sam and the reception team in particular Richard.  😀  love the practice
Amazing vets!! Jess, Grace, Beckie and Olivia were super kind and helpful, would 100% recommend.

We took our cat which we suspected had arthritis. The atmosphere is very calm and spacious and the vet was kind and soothing. Plus our cat was injected with arthritis treatment developed in 2022 which other cat owners in the uk don’t seem to know about( there is also a dog version which my friend who has an arthritic dog didn’t know about). Although my sister in Spain said two of her cats have been on it for a year said her cats have also been transformed. Very happy I changed vets all in all. My dog will also prefer it there as they have treats in the waiting room in jars ! Plus there is plenty of space to separate the animals ( she gets frightened of big dogs !). It was lucky I took my son to a new dentist next door or I wouldn’t have gone in and enquired !
My cat is vastly improved day two and can start rebuilding her muscles.
Thanks

Cannot recommend this vet highly enough! Since joining in July, I’ve felt completely reassured knowing that my nine-year-old Chihuahua Milo is in such kind and caring hands :)

The vets and wider team are wonderful, keeping me updated throughout every procedure via the app and phone calls. They are incredibly thorough when looking at any concerns, and the aftercare is always attentive and supportive. I’m so grateful to have found them!!

Amazing Vet 🙏💯
I've been to many vets and by far this vet has exceeded my expectations, Great staff Price moderate and from the amazing coffee to the amazing waiting area I would never use another vet again.

My first visit to CREATURE COMFORTS and I’m thrilled , polite , friendly ,efficient and very professional- I was totally reassured ( highly neurotic about my fluffy prince!) but also I think very reasonably priced and my cat was calm and unfazed as he knew he was in good hands - I highly recommend this practise
Great experience at creature comforts Notting Hill. The doctor was great and explained everything with much patience and care.

I was recommended to take Milky to this Vet. I found the staff very welcoming and professional. I didn’t experience any pushy upselling, which was very refreshing. There overall 5 star rating on Google is well deserved.
Really helpful with my very anxious cat.
Great vets would recommend anyone to use them

Can honestly say one of the best vets I’ve been to.
The staff are so friendly and knowledgable and you can ask any queries/concerns you have on app and they’ll get back to you quickly. Price wise I find them to be very good. I would recommend them to anyone who is looking for a caring vets.

Special thank you to Lexi (Vet) who was incredibly reassuring when my cat Phoebe became ill quite quickly. Without hesitation she treated her with nausea medication and paste. Phoebe is now yelling for food again with no Vomiting or diarrhoea. Thank you for your kindness, I usually go to Mill Hill but was grateful you saw us at such short notice!
Truly the best vet clinic in London. The entire staff is so kind and welcoming (special shout to Grace, Beth, and Amy), and you can tell that they truly care about the wellbeing of your pets.

This is the best vet clinic I have ever been with or had care for any of my pets ever. Thank you so much for existing, your business model, and all the care and compassion you show to our best friends, the animals.
Thank you Susan! 💜💜 …
Very helpful our cat is doing great the past two days highly recommend.
Amazing team, can’t recommend them enough!

Best vets in London! It’s such a great plan. Receptionist, nurses and doctors are absolutely amazing. Very professional, super kind and caring. They give so much love to my dachshund puppy and they guide me super clearly. I feel so lucky we found them! 💗🙌🏽🐾🙌🏽💗 …
I can sleep well because Bowie has the best care ! Thank you 😇
My cat had a bad ear wound and was carefully tended to by the vet and look forward to the follow up as he’s so much better already.

We can’t thank Jake, Hannah and the entire team at Notting Hill enough for the exceptional care they gave our beloved cat, Teddy. From the moment we walked through the door, we knew he was in the very best hands. Every member of the team showed genuine compassion, professionalism and kindness, making a very stressful time so much easier.

Jake’s expertise and quick decision to refer Teddy to a specialist made all the difference. His judgement ensured Teddy received the expert treatment he needed.

We will always be grateful for the care, support and reassurance Jake, Hannah and the whole team gave us throughout.

We couldn’t recommend Notting Hill more highly. They are an outstanding team who truly care about both their patients and their owners. Thank you for helping to save Teddy and for giving us many more happy memories with our beautiful boy. 🐾

Our son’s dog was handed into the practice and they managed to scan and ring us.  We explained we were  two hours away. They fed and kept him safe until we got there, we are so grateful they took the time to trace us and not sending him to the dog warden.  When we got there he was completely chilled out. We would like to  thank Richard and the team for the care and attention you gave.

We took Gecko to Creature Comforts after struggling to resolve his condition elsewhere. Sam, the surgeon, identified the underlying cause that had been missed by other vets and treated it accordingly. We are absolutely delighted with the outcome and cannot recommend Sam and the team highly enough.

Really helpful from Richard and Jennifer, the onboarding process was seemless and they were so genuine and gentle my cats. I’m so glad I’ve found this clinic and I find myself feeling assured should my pets need anything in the future.

Big thanks to the team !
Great first consultation, all staff & vet were super friendly, clean waiting room. Everything was explained clearly and is really easy to book appointments via their app

Excellent staff very friendly, great with my animal, Cleo, Richard and Jake all great and welcoming.  Have all my pets on a subscription with this place. Would highly recommend.  Prices are good too 😁
First day for me and Nerina to the vet. Nice place, atmosphere and lovely people.
Great
Team is always friendly and welcoming. Aesthetic is great. Very clean. Would recommend
Super efficient and loads of treats of all kinds (incl toys)
Very nice environment for our dog. Very friendly staff too.

Athena had her very first trip to the vet with us, and now I think she's convinced she's queen of the consulting room. The vet was incredibly thorough, listened to all of our questions, and was absolutely on point with their advice. The entire team made her first checkup an absolute breeze, showering her with attention and treats. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience!
Storm rocks! She was beyond helpful in every way imaginable and so lovely to chat with! Can’t say enough good things about her and the staff! x
Always kind capable and on the ball couldn’t be happier than Notting hill creature comfort
Notting hill creature comforts staff are so lovely and kind. Grace and Dr Sam are fab! Always offering humour and kindness. Been a handful of times for my cats, they took such great care of them.

To the outstandingly amazing team of Notting Hill.
I was overwhelmed by the efficiency, dedication, support and care they have given and shown during the very difficult time that we had to say goodbye to our furbaby Logan, specially to Grace Dannette, Sam and Jake.
I highly recommend them! Thank you Creature Comforts Notting Hill and keep up the good work.
My kitten Crumble loved her first visit to the vets with Dr.Lexie
Wonderful place and I love the colours lilac. My cat was calm and well looked after
They are lovely people helped a lot
They always look after our dog so well. Today they fit us in for a last minute appointment as our dog hurt his dew claw. Would highly recommend this vets
Very professional and friendly. Great ambiance. My dog felt relaxed and well looked after.
Always a great help and environment for my dog. Now storm and roxy are besties for resties.
Thank you Kamilla 💜 we're all big Sunny fans here! …
Very caring.

Great experience. The vets are very attentive and always take the time to listen to any concerns about your pet. Vet visits used to be quite stressful for both me and my dog, but since switching to Creature Comforts, we’re both much calmer. The entire team is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always happy to help. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.

The place is fab
Everyone of the staff are so friendly and welcoming
My little kitten love being around there
Love the place and the people around there
Would definitely recommend
Thank you Dimitris 💜 …

Great service at Creature Comforts. Since moving to west London we have changed over vets, and the service is amazing. Very helpful, and our little boy Yoshi seems to always be comfortable when visiting.

Creature Comforts has a wonderful team of professionals, with special recognition for the Notting Hill branch. Both of my cats consistently receive the best care. The team is so attentive, addressing all of our questions and providing the best advice. Our experience there is truly amazing — Venus and Auri receive lots of cuddles, and the attention is precise and detailed. Everything you could ever want for your little babies. Thank you for everything!

We cannot thank Creature Comfort Vets enough for the kindness and compassion shown to Barney during one of the most difficult moments of our lives.

A special thank you goes to Dr Lexi, who looked after Barney in the final moments of his life. Her care, empathy, and gentle manner were truly exceptional. She treated Barney with such dignity and respect, while also providing us with comfort and reassurance when we needed it most.

We will always be grateful for the compassion Dr Lexi showed and for helping Barney pass peacefully and with love. Thank you for making such a difficult experience as gentle as it could possibly be.

Pickle loves going to the vet and not just for the tennis balls & never ending supply of treats! I cannot recommend the lovely Doctor Lexie enough (Alexandra Hunter). So kind and patient and every staff member he encounters always takes the time to say hello. Nothing is too much trouble. Even answering ridiculous questions! Thank you
I love this vet! Great app, friendly and responsive staff, caring vets (not random locums who are always changing), great location and transparent pricing. Oh, and free coffee for pet parents. :)
The service are really good
Thank you Daniel! 💜 …
Brilliant and very professional team. Thank you for take care of my Luna ♥️
The best

I took my cat to Creature Comforts as I was not satisfied with the conclusions of another Vet in W10. As suspected , it was not a good outcome and I was visibly upset . The professionalism and kindness of the Vet and other staff helped no end. My other two cats will be transferring to Creature Comforts .

Creature Comforts are exceptional. The staff are kind, welcoming, and attentive - they made me feel heard and were extremely empathetic. I am very grateful to them for alleviating my distress over the last two days (thank you Dr Chloe, Nurse Olivia, Storm, and everyone else at the clinic who helped me and Cosmo!)

I have a very anxious cat who needed to be seen urgently because he was having breathing problems. Because we took the monthly subscription, we got an urgent appointment within just a couple of hours. The chat service on the app is exceptionally helpful. And on top of all of this, we didn't even have to wait for a follow up - we could get tests done literally the next day. We have only been members for 2 months and I feel like the subscription already paid for itself.

If there is anything at all that I would check beforehand it is the fees related to any required tests. But for the service we received (and because we thankfully have insurance!) I will very honestly say every penny was worth it. Thank you!!!!

We’ve never used this vets before, as it was an emergency visit. Emie the vet was very thorough and detailed, explained everything in detail with advice on the next treatment step care for my dog. He emailed all the details over to my vets. The costs were reasonable considering we went on a Sunday and I highly recommend this vet.  Even the nurse was absolutely pleasant and very sweet with my dog.  Will definitely use them again. Thank you team
Fantastic business model for pet owners. Beautiful offices; lovely, caring staff.

I cannot recomment Creature Comforts (especially the Notting Hill team) enough. From the first message they were so helpful and informative, answering every question I had and reassuring me before I even stepped foot in the practice.

From the first visit it was clear that everyone in there gives their all to every pet that walks in. I could not be happier with the level of care my little cat has recieved here. She was doted upon by everyone she met and cared for to the highest level.

Their app is great too - super user-friendly, and incredibly helpful that they have the chat option.

Would reccomend this practice and this team to anyone. I'm moving out of the city soon and am incredibly sad to have to find another vet as I know they just won't live up.

I’ve left reviews before, but every single time I go to Creature Comforts Notting Hill, everything is so good and so genuinely perfect that I leave feeling happy and somehow end up wanting to write another review 😄

At this point, just expect more reviews from me in the future! 😂

Just an amazing place , real care for the animals and really pleasant as soon as you walk in. They're all soo enthusiastic and that energy puts the animals at ease. My dog loves coming to see the vet now, and she's in such great health thanks to their checks, advice and services. Highly recommend it, not to mention the money you save just paying a subscription and being able to come get a check up whenever. Thank you for your hard work.
This was a routine check up. As all was good with our dog Jake used the time to help him to be calm with the vet. The best vet and vet practise  ever used
Thank you so much for 5* - We're so glad you love the CC experience 💜 …
Really friendly and helpful vets
Lovely people and my dog doesn’t shake when she arrives! So clearly she likes them too! Great app and super flexible and helpful. The membership is very reasonable as well

This team has made me being a first time kitten owner feel reassured that I've chosen the best service. Nala recently had an emergency and was seen within 5 mins of me calling them. Dr Sam is a hero in my kids' eyes (mine too sshh). He was attentive and kept us updated on her progress while she was hospitalised. This eased the anxiety and worry that we all had while we were home. Let's just say she's feeling so much better that she  has resumed 2am zoomies and (indoor) jumps again 😅

My Labrador is almost 10 and has seen many vets, none compare to Creature Comforts. It is a serene, caring and kind environment. Molly recently swallowed a ball and Sam the Vet saved her life. I will be forever grateful. If you’re searching for a Vets where your pet will receive the best care, compassion and kindness then Creature Comforts is where you will find it.

My 12 year Jug had a Routine parasite check up (which is included in our subscription) and had her nails clipped and glands checked (also included) while there despite not being booked for it. Such a good model, especially for routine things, and not being charged the earth every time the dog coughs or had a scratch.
Team are all welcoming, friendly and kind, and clearly adore the pets. Excellent service, best practice (in 40 years of having pets)

Thank you to the Creature Comforts Team for all they do with Roscoe ! He loves coming here for all his treats and cuddles. Special thank you to the host and clinical team ; Beth , Storm , Grace , Veronica & KiKi especially for all the love they give him and for all my coffee's. Couldn't recommend a better vets!
Good

My dogs are cared for by kind and competent staff. Everyone is lovely with reasonable prices too. I couldn’t wish for more. Great value.  You could visit daily if you need to. You are never rushed and never feel that you are being hyper anxious. Best of all is that my pets are happy to attend
As always Creature Comforts provided excellent care for my cat this morning. A wonderful place with great staff.

My dog, Rocky, has become quite the regular fixture at Creature Comforts. What with his regular arthritis jabs, a dog attack just before Christmas that meant an emergency stitch job on his torn ear, and a recent nasty bout of pneumonia, unfortunately we have had to spend a lot of time at CC. On the plus side, it’s like we have become part of the family there. Everyone is so kind and genuinely cares about Rocky’s wellbeing. Special shout out to Storm, who I know is a big fan of Rocky, and who is very generous with the treats. Thanks all and we’ll be back before you know it!!

Blue had his first visit to Creature Comforts, and once again, the care and professionalism from the team were outstanding.
They previously looked after my dog Petra, so I already knew the level of compassion and dedication they bring—but it was reassuring to see that same standard continue with Blue.

Lexie carried out Blue’s assessment and was excellent throughout. She was calm, gentle, and clearly very knowledgeable, taking the time to ensure Blue was comfortable while also explaining everything to me thoroughly. I felt completely confident in her care.

The whole team were welcoming and attentive, making the visit as smooth and stress-free as possible. It’s clear they genuinely care about both their patients and their owners.
A really positive first visit for Blue, and I’m grateful to have such a trusted practice looking after him. Highly recommend Creature Comforts.

Have been roughly 4 or 5 times since August with my kitten and have seen a different vet each time. All have been super friendly and listen to my questions. They have all offered good advise and knowledge and helped with my queries. Very happy with the service and will continue to take my cat here.

Took my girl Puddin in today for her first nail clip and she absolutely loved it! All the staff were so friendly, and she got lots of treats and attention. She’s usually really nervous going to the vets, but she was so happy here 💕 …

Kind, patient and friendly staff working out of the most beautiful clinic.  I am the only person that has handled Mansa (my cat) since she was a small kitten, so I was worried that she might panic, as she has in the past with other people.  However, the vet made all the right moves and handled Mansa with no fuss at all.

Beth and the team at Notting Hill are exceptional! He is registered with my local vet but they went out of their way to fit Mogwai in with their cardiologist Sam. Sent pictures and videos of Mogwai looking very comfortable in his heated pet pod. Excellent aftercare. Couldn’t recommend them enough!

I had a pleasant experience with creature comforts, the staff was amazing they looked after my pets and me which has brilliant Service,so happy for them for all the work that was done. Thank you to all and especially the manager of creature comforts.

Brought my dog lassie in for surgery as she has cancer and I couldn’t ask for a better vets to look after my dog she was so cared for and as a person with learning disabilities Annisa and Sam really took time explaining her operation to me and I’m very grateful. Also the reception team storm and grace were so nice during the whole process too , will bring lassie back here for sure

Sam has been amazing as Dave’s main vet – always calm, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. Every time we’ve visited, the whole team has been just as kind, helpful, and reassuring, which makes such a difference. You can really tell they all love what they do.

A big thank you from me and Dave 🐾 – we wouldn’t go anywhere else!

Harley has been coming to CC since the first one opened in when he was just 10 weeks old  - and  was one of the first pups to join up.   He is now 2 and CC now have 10 practices so a big congrats to them both for being the best.    Without doubt the vet practice is outstanding  - with the kindest & most professional vets, in the most stunning of surroundings and with the smartest approach.  The treat bar is a winner too and he wont walk past without dragging me in to get a pick and mix bag ! Keep it up CC.   Much love Harley and me x
Went on the lovely matcha puppy walk today with Chico - he loves coming to the vets . Storm the receptionist is always super lovely and helpful when he comes in . Couldn’t  recommend a better vet’s .

Popped into Creature Comforts in Notting Hill to ask about membership and check out the practice — Storm at the front desk was so lovely and gave me loads of helpful information. The place looks great and I’ll definitely be signing my dog up soon! 🐶✨ …
Always very well looked after - caring lovely team Thank you 🙏 …

We are so grateful for the Creature Comforts team. We have been coming here for two years and they have been really wonderful, everyone is really friendly, knowledgeable and the atmosphere feels very safe and serene. More recently, they were particularly understanding, supportive and empathetic through a health scare we had with our 5 year old rescue cat. We couldn’t be happier to have this team looking after our little guy!
Great service, staff are super friendly and attentive. My frenchie was quite anxious, but they definitely helped her feel more at ease.100% would recommend.

I was looking after a friend's puppy when she suddenly started behaving strangely. Knowing she was a Creature Comforts patient, I called the location I thought she went to around noon to talk about the symptoms; they reached out to the location she actually went to so that they could review her file and told me how to handle the symptoms. She got a little worse and being the "nervous auntie," I called back about 3:00 and they scheduled an appointment for us to come in 20 minutes later at our closest clinic. Grace and Dr Kiekie couldn't have been more welcoming at Notting Hill. They took care of the puppy AND me, reassuring both of us that she was going to be just fine. Dr Kiekie provided the necessary treatment all while keeping both of us calm, giving follow-up instructions, dispensing treats, and keeping the puppy's owner updated. I can't recommend Creature Comforts enough- they're great with two- and four-legged clients!

Guys, I don’t know, why I didn’t change our previous vet clinic for so long!

Everything is amazing, from the start till the end!
Zefir loved everyone, played there, walked outside with nurses, was truly satisfied, especially after the surgery! I’m impressed x

Thanks everything , great team! If we won’t leave London, we will for sure make a membership with you ❤️

It was love from the first consultation:)
Also everyone is so kind, app is very comfortable to use!
It’s our first visit and we experienced extremely friendly staff. Nice and clean. My cat felt comfortable
Hi Roberto, thank you so much for your paw-sitive rating! We love seeing your lovely Sammie!
Hi Danielle, thank you so much for your high rating! We've loved getting to know you and Archie and welcoming you to Creature Comforts.

I took my cat, Cody, to Creature Comforts a couple of days ago. First time at this vet. They were so nice and Penny was very informative. My only issue with this practice is that they aren't really transparent with the prices until you ask. They even offered to have a 2nd look at Cody after I informed them that I wouldn't be able to afford the scan that they advised

They are truly kind and lovely in there and I do recommend them.
I regret not having learned about them earlier. Exceedingly professional, compassionate, and empathetic.

My daughters kitten has been under the care of creature comforts notting hill since around12 weeks old and is now 7 months old.
The vets and all other staff are so lovely, friendly and welcoming. The whole experience is very chilled, doesn't feel clinical at all, putting both pet parents and pets as ease. Simple member subscription for unlimited appointments 7 days a week, lots of choice of appointment times and a very professional service. I am confident our pet is in safe and caring hands.
Really happy to have Creature Comforts vet close to home. Always careful and professional

My 15-year-old dog, Monte, gives 2 paws up to Creature Comforts Notting Hill and Chelsea! We're new to the practice and introducing my senior chap to anything unfamiliar can be stressful. But the teams at both clinics are super welcoming and friendly. The facilities are spotless and calming. Special shout-out to Dr. Sam Joseph who has been amazing with Monte (who needed some dental work). Lastly, it was really important for me to find an independent veterinary clinic that wasn't bound to corporate interests. Creature Comforts is that place - putting care and love for animals before profit.

Best vet clinic in London. We've been going to creature comfort since we got our puppy. Our a year ago. Our dog LOVES the vet team, even after a surgery and vaccines, he LOVES going there. The staff genuinely cares about the wellbeing of the dogs and you can tell. They are always kind and excited seeing our dog. There are never a lot of people / dogs in the waiting area, which is good as dogs can get quite nervous in tight spaces with other dogs. Super easy to schedule an appointment in the app as well.

We came in for a second opinion and it turned out to be absolutely the right decision. If we already had to resolve something, we are truly grateful that we found this place and we will definitely be staying with them moving forward.

The kindness, professionalism, and overall organisation are outstanding. Everything feels calm, clean, and genuinely caring, which makes such a difference when you are worried about your pet.

I also absolutely love their app. It is beautifully designed, very clear, and allows me to easily track everything my dog needs, all in one place. Services like this are rare and incredibly valuable.

I would wholeheartedly recommend them.

Honestly the single greatest vet I have been to.

Staff are welcoming and caring. Treatment has been transparent and realistic when it comes to diagnosis. They have taken great care of my cat.

You can tell how kind the atmosphere is by the number of dogs on walks that drag their owners in voluntarily.

They also have a monthly “plan” that has paid for itself with our cats (now frequent) cancer visits. It's been the best find.

Much love to Drs Jake, Sam and Chloe for all their care. And to the reception staff who keep checking in.

Ps, they have an app where you can drop in notes about your pets health and it's been really useful on those days where I wasn't sure what to do.

Jake at Creature Comforts in Notting Hill has treated both our dogs. His calm professionalism is welcome after a day’s worrying about the latest veterinary crisis. He always explains the nature of the problem and always seeks approval before treatment. Even the most excitable patient is calmer after treatment — the owner too!
Very professional  Chloe is   wonderful very knowledgeable but still friendly  and efficient, would recommend 👌 😀 👍 …
Sam and Simon and the team here are great and we really appreciate their care towards our furry friends, whether it's been advice, routine vaccinations or surgery.

I’ve been registered at Creature comforts Notting Hill with my cat for a year now and I’ve never been so satisfied with any vet before. We always feel welcomed and I have confident leaving her there for any tests/ treatments needed to be done. And I’m saying as someone who has had bad experiences with vets before! I especially appreciate the fact that they send pictures throughout her stay there:)

As a first-time dog owner who’s anxious about everything, Creature Comforts Notting Hill has been amazing.

Last month, my puppy had a toe fracture requiring splint care and bandage changes every 2–3 days, and I can’t imagine how stressful it would have been without this friendly, professional clinic. Everyone is easy to communicate with, proactive with requests like referrals and insurance, and my shy puppy actually loves coming here. Our recent follow-up X-ray shows good bone healing and remodeling. Highly recommend!
Very caring and professional, I was assured my dog was well looked after .
Creature comforts is amazing! They have been so helpful, especially Dr. Clio. Can't recommend them enough! Don't think twice before getting the membership for your pups or cats!
My dog loves going here and is always well cared for. Great staff all around!

I have never had such an amazing vet experience! My senior cat, Milou, had very extreme bronchial disease and was never really treated with proper care from vets, until we came to Creature Comforts. The vet team truly cares for their patients, our main vet Clio was absolutely amazing. She always handled Milou with love and compassion (despite Milou's anger while at the vets). At Creature Comforts you are treated as returning family. An actual village style vet in the middle of bustling Notting Hill. We’ve previously already been visiting the Saint John’s Wood branch (which is also fantastic!), but this time my cat needed some tests that were only available at the Notting Hill branch, along with a follow-up afterwards. I’m very happy to have trusted them with my sweet old potato. We saw Dr Sam and Dr Grace (she also works at Saint John’s Woods), both of whom were incredibly caring and gentle with my cat.

What I love most about Creature Comforts, regardless of the branch, is that I never feel like I’m being treated as a cash cow whenever I raise a concern.

When my cat started limping, Dr Grace suggested starting with the most vital checks, like blood and urine tests, which were processed in about an hour (on Christmas Eve, by the way!) rather than pushing us towards an extensive full-body check-up. I had my other cat die of liver failure just a day after one of my previous vets discharged her after a full-body X-ray, multiple ultrasounds and a water infusion, while they were still waiting for her blood tests to come through. So I have quite a trauma and some trust issues, as you can imagine. This much more thoughtful approach from Dr Grace meant a lot to me. She also went above and beyond by researching another facility that could provide my cat with radiotherapy. Another facility! Not within Creature Comforts. I mean, I'm quite sure that this is not something Creature Comforts would benefit from money wise. They genuinely prioritise the pet’s wellbeing over personal gain and this is what has helped me build so much trust in them.

Or another example, my cat has mild CKD, and I asked if an ultrasound was necessary to monitor it. Dr Sam explained in detail why blood and urine tests are more than sufficient at her stage of the disease. I could keep going, I have a couple of other examples, but long story short, when they suggest a test or procedure, I feel completely confident in its necessity and reasoning. This also makes me feel more much more secure in asking questions, I’m not afraid to drop a name of some expensive procedure when discussing a problem, as I know that it won’t be used “against” me.

Lastly, I absolutely loved the photo updates of my bun in their app. Just look at this cozy blanket! It was very comforting and reassuring to see that she was so cared for before, during, and after her procedures.
